title: DLT Khon Kaen Queue System
description: End-to-end real-time queue management system for the Department of Land Transport. Features citizen online booking, QR code on-site check-in, live queue status broadcasting via WebSockets, and administrative control panels.

title: SMOCP.COM
description: Student union portal and digital operations platform for CP KKU. Led infrastructure, cloud deployment, and system architecture to handle event registrations, ticketing, and organizational announcements.

title: MobiStock
description: Enterprise-grade DBMS stock and inventory management web solution. Built with relational database integrity, tracking SKU shipments, low-stock alerts, purchase orders, and supplier audits.

title: KKU VALONTEER
description: Web application for managing volunteer activities and verifying accumulated volunteer hours for students at Khon Kaen University. Replaces paper-based documentation with a secure, efficient workflow.

title: GPS Fleet Tracking System
description: Real-time logistics and fleet tracking dashboard developed during Hackathon. Built an interactive telemetry monitoring interface that tracks truck coordinates, dispatch statuses, and driver route compliance.

title: Haptics Network
description: Low-latency network communication project designed to transmit haptic data (position, rotation, force) over LAN using custom UDP binary payloads, Jitter Buffer, and Dead Reckoning algorithms.

title: JaiMaReawReaw QR Payment
description: Streamlined merchant QR payment generation and verification utility. Generates PromptPay dynamic QR codes and validates incoming transaction confirmations instantly.

title: EDS — Education System
description: Comprehensive institutional campus management platform deployed for Udonthani Technical College, unifying administrator portals, instructor grading modules, and student schedules.
